translation: (This refers to the Tiantu point, the meeting of Yinwei and the Ren vessel; needle one cun, moxa three zhuang.) The Maijing (Pulse Classic) says: When the cunkou pulse comes tight, fine, and solid, long reaching to the guan, it is the Ren vessel. When it moves, one suffers lower abdominal pain encircling the navel, drawing down to the pubic bone, with cutting pain in the genitals; take Guanyuan (CV4) to treat it. It also says: When, at the side of the cun opening, the pulse is u丸丸u (round and rolling), it is the Ren vessel.
